items.title: Williams Companies Inc's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: This article first appeared on GuruFocus.  Williams Companies Inc (NYSE:WMB) recently announced a total dividend of $0.53 per share with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-11, including $0.53 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-28.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
